baseline_prompt_en: Create a vertical, photorealistic cinematic fashion photograph: an unmistakably adult woman fighter pilot, with her facial identity closely matching the supplied portrait reference, walks toward the camera carrying her flight helmet on a wide military runway at golden hour. A parked KF-21 fighter jet dominates the background, recognizable by its angular gray fuselage, twin canted tails, and twin-engine form. Style the scene as a sensual high-fashion aviation editorial: a precisely fitted olive flight suit with the upper zipper lowered to a fitted black base-layer neckline, sleeves pushed to the forearms, confident hip-led stride, steady direct gaze, and long dark wavy hair lifted by runway wind. Use a slightly low full-body perspective and 35mm environmental framing so her face remains clear while the aircraft feels imposing. Warm rim light catches her hair and suit seams, balanced by cool metallic reflections from the jet and textured runway heat shimmer. Preserve natural skin texture, authentic fabric wear, and realistic aviation scale.
